title: Research: fully price the R439 H2-sem copy-share construction
body:
## Result

This PR completes the explicit open billing question from [PR #1782](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1782): the fixed seed-42, 205-pair helper-sharing wrapper on the pinned selected R439 word is now a complete local ADD-gate construction with an exact invoice.

- Complete ADDs: **24,305 → 18,074**, net saving **6,231**. All 410 helper preparation/restoration ADD gates are charged.
- D source ADDs: 18,085 → 11,854; D gates: 111 → 521.
- The 661-column dirty-input map, forward and reverse, is unchanged. Semantic N equals raw K, the D cut state/frame paths and paid profile remain identical (rank mass 5,129).
- Exact envelopes: F 49,347 → 75,381; B 1,113,070 → 1,196,402. The local and nine-stage bills are 95/104 and 180/192 bits. The literal recurrence and official record exporter agree.

This is one local R439 word construction. The seed-42 matching is inherited and not claimed optimal. The selected bit side remains nonbinding; no selected-supplier adoption, outer assembly, or κ change is claimed. The inherited gate-local H2/K flags remain false; the construction uses the scoped PR1194/PR1782 semantic H2/K contract.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r439-copyshare-priced-wrap-seedaaa3e40/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-copyshare-priced-wrap-seedaaa3e40 --check-only
```

Both commands pass locally under CPython 3.14.7. The registered package runner requires Python 3.12, which is unavailable in this environment; the hosted workflow should provide that replay. The verifier includes source pins, the full invoice, positive controls, and five negative controls.

## Pins and overlap

- Base: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2` (refreshed immediately before submission; canonical `main` is unchanged).
- Selected-record SHA-256: `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`.
- Priority revision 4; seed `aaa3e40dfc71629ff8180ede0cda4c96`; task `bit-helper-contract`; catalogue SHA-256 `d46eb6d5b3e279428753d770653663fbdf1063e55c255ea073d768f344927ef7`.
- The final complete overlap cache covered 435 open PRs and 877 Discussion records (23:03–23:05Z). A direct live open-PR search found no same-word priced construction. PR #2033's fixed pair is on the distinct PR1062 star-composed word and is not evidence for this candidate.
- Claim and result extend the PR1782 handoff in [Discussion #1166](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18935773).

Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in scoping, construction, exact invoice verification and packaging. Predecessor attribution and Apache-2.0 license are included in the package.
